what: The block of four unlabelled photographs printed below Q7 on printed p81 (left column and lower-right of the page), each showing one problem of urbanisation the student must suggest measures for: (1) top-left — a row of power-station/factory chimneys and cooling towers belching smoke against a sunset sky (air pollution); (2) middle-right — a street stall wall stacked with dozens of loudspeaker horns with people crowded in front of it (noise pollution); (3) bottom-left — a large open dump of mixed plastic and household waste heaped on a hillside (solid waste); (4) bottom-right — a stagnant urban water body choked with floating garbage beside a footbridge and shanties (water pollution). The pictures carry no captions, so the four problems can only be identified from the images.
